scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.render-build: npm install && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss
